npcs.name: Alex
dialogue: Hey! I'm Alex. I spend way too much time around founders and coffee.
Every great startup starts with a real problem — not a cool feature.
Go talk to people on the other islands. You'll learn fast.

npcs.name: Maya
dialogue: I'm Maya. This is Market Island — where ideas meet customers.
You can't build product-market fit in a vacuum.
Talk to shop owners, listen to complaints, find what people actually need.

npcs.name: Sam
dialogue: Sam here. Tower Island is where founders learn to pitch and scale.
Investors don't fund ideas — they fund traction and teams.
Build something people want, then come back and tell your story.
